changelog: v2.4.2 — Documentation-only: adds scenario D (just-installed welcome prompt). When the agent detects a fresh install with no applied-state stamp, it asks the user once whether to apply a logo now, optionally picking a random set from logos/ (excluding 'original'). Asks once, never re-prompts. No code change; relies entirely on the existing apply-logo.sh <set-name> flow.
summary: Personalize the OpenClaw WebUI (control panel) favicon — i.e. the OpenClaw / crawfish browser-tab logo. Deploys a bundled logo set (logos/<set-name>/) to all...
